title: gitiup attestation document (v1)
description:
A run manifest plus the signatures over it. The signed payload is the canonical encoding of the `manifest` member, wrapped in DSSE PAE: signature over "DSSEv1" SP len(payload_type) SP payload_type SP len(payload) SP payload. See ADR-0001 (docs/adr/0001-attestation-encoding-hash-and-signature.md).

Stored as kv/attestation/<hex of sha256(canonical(this document))> and pointed at by refs/attestations/<commit oid>, so an ordinary git fetch carries proof.

payload_type.description: DSSE payload type of the signed bytes; recorded so a future payload type cannot be checked with these rules.

signatures.description: One entry per signer; a quorum appends entries without changing the RunDigest. May be empty only for an unsigned record staged before signing.
signatures.x-gitiup-note: One entry per key_id: an identity casts one vote (giti-msi.9).

key_id.description: Unpadded base64 of sha256 over the SSH public-key blob: exactly what `ssh-keygen -lf` prints. Derived from public_key at verification time, never taken on trust.

algorithm.description: Raw Ed25519 (RFC 8032), verified strictly (no weak keys, no malleable encodings).

public_key.description: OpenSSH public-key line, without a comment: base64 of string "ssh-ed25519" + string <32-byte key>.

sig.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of the 64-byte signature over the PAE bytes.
